rationale.complete: Rounds 1 and 2 done. Round 2: dated pre-registration, two amendments before real data, synthetic worlds on the real skeleton with bootstrapped real tails, a leave-one-period-out calibrated monitor, heavy-tailed baseline variants, a format presence rule, a provider DiD, period blocks and estimates, an operator rule. Missing: the reserved-data run, a scaffold-change observable, a powered provider DiD.
rationale.faithfulness: Every FAR is now out-of-sample and distribution-free (B, F to 2); the synthetic study predicted the real per-channel FAR. Dated changes remain the ground truth. Not higher: the pre-registered monitor is mixed (FAR 0.085), scaffold changes are at chance, the S fix is post hoc, NE40 is a recovery. Scorecard A1 B2 C1 D1 E1 F2 G2 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Operator-ready: three cheap channels with stated thresholds and out-of-sample FARs, computable from any swarm's logs; it dates drive, format and goal changes. It cannot see scaffold or prompt changes.

one_line: Calibrated out of sample, a schema diff plus log-count operator counters plus topic shift dates drive, format and goal changes at FAR 0.085 per quiet day (0.051 with provider dates catalogued); scaffold changes stay at chance.

models.note: Platform and drive steps show as synchronous rule and counter changes; behavior-mix shifts stay below day-to-day noise
Content centroid shift (C3) detects goal steps (hit 0.57, p 0.003)

v2.claim: A schema diff of the raw record is an operator-grade change detector: 0/34 placebo false alarms; it dates NE14, NE17 and NE45 to the day and found 6 undocumented provider API changes. The fused five-channel alarm is too noisy (18% false alarms, AUC 0.68); topic shift remains the goal detector (AUC 0.89)
v2.scope: 282 non-holdout days, 217 dated events; natives NE14, NE45, NE43, NE40

ladder.factor: ground truth agrees (documented events dated to the day)
penalty: fused-alarm predictions failed; S channel credit partly post hoc

v2.decision: monitor the raw record's schema to catch platform changes; use topic shift for goals

raters.claim: A daily record-schema diff (platform-wide new or retired field-name/type signatures) dates platform and provider format changes to the day with 0/34 placebo false alarms (NE14, NE17, NE45, six undocumented provider API changes); it does not see prompt-only or behavioral changes. Excluded: the fused five-channel alarm (FAR 0.18), NE40, M/O channels.
